root_cause: The clang-tidy static analysis build completed successfully; only the artifact upload step ('Upload compile_commands') failed with what is almost certainly a transient infrastructure error (artifact storage backend unavailable or token expiry). The actual clang-tidy analysis found no issues in PR #37340's change to llm_infer_request.cpp. Run attempt 2 was triggered automatically and is currently in progress.
recommended_actions: Wait for run attempt 2 (currently in_progress) to complete - it is likely to succeed
If attempt 2 also fails at artifact upload, consider re-running only the failed jobs
If the pattern recurs, investigate GitHub Actions artifact storage issues on aks-linux-16-cores-32gb runners
prevention_strategies: Artifact upload failures are transient infrastructure issues; automatic retry via run_attempt 2 is the standard mitigation. No code changes needed.
historical_context: Similar artifact upload failures have occurred before: 'RISC-V clang-tidy build fails - artifact upload FinalizeArtifact returns 403 Forbidden' (2 occurrences) and several other artifact upload failures across different jobs. All were Infrastructure category and resolved by re-run.
